_comment: Maps the [TAG] of policy.md §2 docstring citations to the reference documents under this directory (stems of <name>.md). Maintained by scripts/reference_coverage.py (--register, --rebuild-registry) and by scripts/dataset_pipeline.py --source TAG=path.
